<thought>We need the number of distinct proton environments. The only way to get that is to obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum for the target compound. The tool proton_nmr_spectra requires a SMILES string, but no SMILES is provided in the prompt. Assuming the system has a default compound loaded, we can call the tool without arguments to retrieve its spectrum and then count the distinct signals.</thought>
